comment: Andilesin B originates from the spontaneous elimination of acetate from Acetylandilesin A (produced by AndG). AndH reduces Andilesin B to produce Andilesin C.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 improved reaction descriptions.

reactions.description: Reduction of meroterpenoid intermediate andilesin B in the andilesin biosynthetic pathway.
Conversion of andilesin B to andilesin C.
